events.title: The Bitter Struggle: Superintelligence, Superpowers, and the Fate of the World
events.host: Georgetown SFS Mortara Center for International Studies
events.description: Book talk on Ben Buchanan's The Bitter Struggle about superintelligence and US-China AI competition; Georgetown stop of the book tour (SAIS stop is Nov 11).
events.why: Central AI-geopolitics book by a former White House AI adviser; a short trip from SAIS.

events.title: Disrupting Politics: A Front Row Seat to the Collision of Technology & Democracy (Book Forum)
events.location: Cato Institute, 1000 Massachusetts Ave NW, Washington, DC
events.description: Book forum on Facebook's political controversies, AI and political misinformation, government pressure on platforms and tech companies' influence on public discourse.
events.why: Platform governance and AI misinformation debate, in person near SAIS.

events.title: AI and Biosecurity: Managing Risks, Preserving Progress
events.description: RAND online event on managing biosecurity risks from AI while preserving scientific progress.
events.why: AI-bio risk governance from RAND; easy to join online.

events.title: Workshop on Assessing U.S.-China AI Capabilities: Trajectories, Uncertainties, and Strategic Implications
events.location: Asia Society Northern California, San Francisco, CA
events.description: Full-day workshop assessing US and Chinese AI capabilities, uncertainties in their trajectories and the strategic implications.
events.why: Squarely on US-China AI competition for Bay Area tech-policy followers.

events.title: Executive Roundtable - U.S.-China Relations: From APEC Summit Outcomes to Strategic Realities
events.location: Asia Society Northern California, San Francisco, CA
events.description: Executive roundtable on US-China relations after the APEC summit.
events.why: US-China relations broadly; tech is only part of it.

events.title: Technology Supply Chain Security for Space and Defense
events.description: GMF and Swedish aerospace company ECAPS host a closed-door roundtable on technology supply-chain security for space and defense.
events.why: Relevant transatlantic space supply-chain topic, but closed-door.

events.title: Sip & Solve: AI and Democracy
events.location: SNF Agora Institute, Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, MD
events.host: JHU Data Science and AI Institute
events.description: Informal JHU Data Science and AI Institute session on AI and democracy at the SNF Agora Institute.
events.why: AI and democracy discussion at Hopkins, but in Baltimore.
